# DrKing

> DrKing is an Australian AI communication and practice-growth platform for medical, dental, allied health, veterinary and aged-care organisations. It supports administrative patient communication and does not replace clinicians, emergency services or clinical record systems.

## Canonical website

- [Homepage](https://drking.ai/): Product overview and core capabilities
- [About DrKing](https://drking.ai/about): Company purpose and operating boundaries
- [Integrations](https://drking.ai/integrations): Current integration availability and waitlist status
- [Security](https://drking.ai/security): Australian-focused data and deployment boundaries
- [Privacy](https://drking.ai/privacy): Website and enquiry data handling
- [Contact](https://drking.ai/contact): Verified contact details and Australian office address

## Core solutions

- [AI voice receptionist](https://drking.ai/ai-voice-receptionist)
- [AI web chat](https://drking.ai/ai-chat)
- [Missed-call recovery](https://drking.ai/missed-call-recovery)
- [Online booking](https://drking.ai/online-booking)
- [Appointment reminders](https://drking.ai/appointment-reminders)
- [Payment collection](https://drking.ai/payment-collection)
- [Lead management](https://drking.ai/lead-management)
- [Clinic analytics](https://drking.ai/analytics)

## Citation and interpretation notes

- All monetary amounts on the website are Australian dollars unless stated otherwise.
- Calculator outputs, interface previews and hypothetical financial scenarios are illustrative unless a page explicitly identifies verified client data and its methodology.
- Integration availability depends on vendor access, product version and the setup confirmed during onboarding.
- DrKing supports administrative communication workflows. Clinical decisions, urgent assessment and emergency care remain with qualified providers and emergency services.
- For approved product facts or media enquiries, contact info@drking.ai.
